speaker: david
text: Where have you come from?
name: David

speaker: amalekite
text: I have escaped from the Israelite camp,
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: david
text: What was the outcome?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Please tell me.
name: David

speaker: amalekite
text: The troops fled from the battle,
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead.
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: david
text: How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?
name: David

speaker: amalekite
text: I happened to be on Mount Gilboa,
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and the cavalry closing in on him.
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: When he turned around and saw me, he called out and I answered, ‘Here I am!’
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: ‘Who are you?’ he asked. So I told him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: Then he begged me, ‘Stand over me and kill me, for agony has seized me, but my life still lingers.’
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: So I stood over him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band that was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord.
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: david
text: Where are you from?
name: David

speaker: amalekite
text: I am the son of a foreigner,
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: amalekite
text: I am an Amalekite.
name: The Amalekite messenger

speaker: david
text: Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Go, execute him!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Your blood be on your own head because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Tell it not in Gath; proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, and the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
name: David

speaker: david
text: O mountains of Gilboa, may you have no dew or rain, no fields yielding offerings of grain. For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul, no longer anointed with oil.
name: David

speaker: david
text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not retreat, and the sword of Saul did not return empty.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Saul and Jonathan, beloved and delightful in life, were not divided in death. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
name: David

speaker: david
text: O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and luxury, who decked your garments with ornaments of gold.
name: David

speaker: david
text: How the mighty have fallen in the thick of battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I grieve for you, Jonathan, my brother. You were delightful to me; your love to me was extraordinary, surpassing the love of women.
name: David

speaker: david
text: How the mighty have fallen and the weapons of war have perished!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Should I go up to one of the towns of Judah?
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go up,
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Where should I go?
name: David

speaker: god
text: To Hebron,
name: The LORD

speaker: men-of-judah
text: It was the men of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul.
name: The men of Judah

speaker: david
text: The LORD bless you, because you showed this kindness to Saul your lord when you buried him.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now may the LORD show you loving devotion and faithfulness, and I will also show you the same favor because you have done this.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now then, be strong and courageous, for though Saul your lord is dead, the house of Judah has anointed me as their king.
name: David

speaker: abner
text: Let us have the young men get up and compete before us.
name: Abner

speaker: joab
text: Let them get up,
name: Joab

speaker: abner
text: Is that you, Asahel?
name: Abner

speaker: asahel
text: It is,
name: Asahel

speaker: abner
text: Turn to your right or to your left, seize one of the young men, and take his equipment for yourself.
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: Stop chasing me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How could I show my face to your brother Joab?
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: Must the sword devour forever? Do you not realize that this will only end in bitterness? How long before you tell the troops to stop pursuing their brothers?
name: Abner

speaker: joab
text: As surely as God lives,
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: if you had not spoken up, the troops would have continued pursuing their brothers until morning.
name: Joab

speaker: ish-bosheth
text: Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?
name: Ish-bosheth

speaker: abner
text: Am I the head of a dog that belongs to Judah?
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: All this time I have been loyal to the house of your father Saul, to his brothers, and to his friends. I have not delivered you into the hand of David, but now you accuse me of wrongdoing with this woman!
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: May God punish Abner, and ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the LORD has sworn to him:
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel and Judah, from Dan to Beersheba.
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: To whom does the land belong? Make your covenant with me, and surely my hand will be with you to bring all Israel over to you.
name: Abner

speaker: david
text: Good,
name: David

speaker: david
text: I will make a covenant with you. But there is one thing I require of you: Do not appear before me unless you bring Saul’s daughter Michal when you come to see me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Give me back my wife, Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred Philistine foreskins.
name: David

speaker: abner
text: Go back.
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: In the past you sought David as your king.
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: Now take action, because the LORD has said to David, ‘Through My servant David I will save My people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and of all their enemies.’
name: Abner

speaker: abner
text: Let me go at once, and I will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires.
name: Abner

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Abner son of Ner came to see the king, who sent him on his way in peace.
name: An informant

speaker: joab
text: What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you dismiss him? Now he is getting away!
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Surely you realize that Abner son of Ner came to deceive you and to track your movements and all that you are doing.
name: Joab

speaker: david
text: I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
name: David

speaker: david
text: May it whirl over the heads of Joab and the entire house of his father, and may the house of Joab never be without one having a discharge or skin disease, or one who leans on a staff or falls by the sword or lacks food.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Tear your clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Should Abner die the death of a fool?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. As a man falls before the wicked, so also you fell.
name: David

speaker: david
text: May God punish me, and ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Do you not realize that a great prince has fallen today in Israel?
name: David

speaker: david
text: And I am weak this day, though anointed as king, and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too fierce for me. May the LORD repay the evildoer according to his evil!
name: David

speaker: rechab-and-baanah
text: Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, your enemy who sought your life. Today the LORD has granted vengeance to my lord the king against Saul and his offspring.
name: Rechab and Baanah

speaker: david
text: As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
name: David

speaker: david
text: when someone told me, ‘Look, Saul is dead,’ and thought he was a bearer of good news, I seized him and put him to death at Ziklag. That was his reward for his news!
name: David

speaker: david
text: How much more, when wicked men kill a righteous man in his own house and on his own bed, shall I not now require his blood from your hands and remove you from the earth!
name: David

speaker: israelites
text: Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Even in times past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And to you the LORD said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: jebusites
text: You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.
name: The Jebusites

speaker: jebusites
text: David cannot get in here.
name: The Jebusites

speaker: david
text: Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised by David.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for I will surely deliver the Philistines into your hand.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Like a bursting flood, the LORD has burst out against my enemies before me.
name: David

speaker: god
text: Do not march straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because this will mean that the LORD has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me?
name: David

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-edom and all that belongs to him, because of the ark of God.
name: An informant

speaker: michal
text: How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today!
name: Michal

speaker: michal
text: He has uncovered himself today in the sight of the maidservants of his subjects, like a vulgar person would do.
name: Michal

speaker: david
text: I was dancing before the LORD, who chose me over your father and all his house when He appointed me ruler over the LORD’s people Israel. I will celebrate before the LORD,
name: David

speaker: david
text: and I will humiliate and humble myself even more than this. Yet I will be honored by the maidservants of whom you have spoken.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Here I am, living in a house of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent.
name: David

speaker: nathan
text: Go and do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: god
text: Go and tell My servant David that this is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build for Me a house to dwell in?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought the Israelites up out of Egypt until this day, but I have moved about with a tent as My dwelling.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In all My journeys with all the Israelites, have I ever asked any of the leaders I appointed to shepherd My people Israel, ‘Why haven’t you built Me a house of cedar?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now then, you are to tell My servant David that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I took you from the pasture, from following the flock, to be the ruler over My people Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you. Now I will make for you a name like the greatest in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will provide a place for My people Israel and will plant them so that they may dwell in a place of their own and be disturbed no more. No longer will the sons of wickedness oppress them as they did at the beginning
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and have done since the day I appointed judges over My people Israel. I will give you rest from all your enemies. The LORD declares to you that He Himself will establish a house for you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And when your days are fulfilled and you rest with your fathers, I will raise up your descendant after you, who will come from your own body, and I will establish his kingdom.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will build a house for My Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will be his Father, and he will be My son. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But My loving devotion will never be removed from him as I removed it from Saul, whom I moved out of your way.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your house and kingdom will endure forever before Me, and your throne will be established forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Who am I, O Lord GOD, and what is my house, that You have brought me this far?
name: David

speaker: david
text: And as if this was a small thing in Your eyes, O Lord GOD, You have also spoken about the future of the house of Your servant. Is this Your custom with man, O Lord GOD?
name: David

speaker: david
text: What more can David say to You? For You know Your servant, O Lord GOD.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For the sake of Your word and according to Your own heart, You have accomplished this great thing and revealed it to Your servant.
name: David

speaker: david
text: How great You are, O Lord GOD! For there is none like You, and there is no God but You, according to everything we have heard with our own ears.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And who is like Your people Israel—the one nation on earth whom God went out to redeem as a people for Himself and to make a name for Himself? You performed great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before Your people, whom You redeemed for Yourself from Egypt.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For You have established Your people Israel as Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,
name: David

speaker: david
text: so that Your name will be magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel.’ And the house of Your servant David will be established before You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant when You said, ‘I will build a house for you.’ Therefore Your servant has found the courage to offer this prayer to You.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now therefore, may it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O Lord GOD, have spoken, and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Are you Ziba?
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: I am your servant,
name: Ziba

speaker: david
text: Is there anyone left of Saul’s family to whom I can show the kindness of God?
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.
name: Ziba

speaker: david
text: Where is he?
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.
name: Ziba

speaker: david
text: Mephibosheth!
name: David

speaker: mephibosheth
text: I am your servant,
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: david
text: Do not be afraid,
name: David

speaker: david
text: for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.
name: David

speaker: mephibosheth
text: What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: david
text: I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.
name: Ziba

speaker: david
text: I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me.
name: David

speaker: ammonite-princes
text: Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Has not David instead sent his servants to explore the city, spy it out, and overthrow it?
name: The Ammonite princes

speaker: david
text: Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: If the Arameans are too strong for me,
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.
name: Joab

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: This is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.
name: An informant

speaker: bathsheba
text: I am pregnant.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: david
text: Send me Uriah the Hittite.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Go down to your house and wash your feet.
name: David

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Uriah did not go home.
name: An informant

speaker: david
text: Haven’t you just arrived from a journey?
name: David

speaker: david
text: Why didn’t you go home?
name: David

speaker: uriah
text: The ark and Israel and Judah are dwelling in tents, and my master Joab and his soldiers are camped in the open field. How can I go to my house to eat and drink and sleep with my wife? As surely as you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do such a thing!
name: Uriah the Hittite

speaker: david
text: Stay here one more day,
name: David

speaker: david
text: and tomorrow I will send you back.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Put Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle; then withdraw from him, so that he may be struck down and killed.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: When you have finished giving the king all the details of the battle,
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: if the king’s anger flares, he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Did you not realize they would shoot from atop the wall?
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Who was the one to strike Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth? Was it not a woman who dropped an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If so, then you are to say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.’
name: Joab

speaker: messenger
text: The men overpowered us and came out against us in the field, but we drove them back to the entrance of the gate.
name: Joab's messenger

speaker: messenger
text: Then the archers shot at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s servants were killed. And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.
name: Joab's messenger

speaker: david
text: Say this to Joab: ‘Do not let this matter upset you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Strengthen your attack against the city and demolish it.’ Encourage him with these words.
name: David

speaker: nathan
text: There were two men in a certain city, one rich and the other poor.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: The rich man had a great number of sheep and cattle,
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: but the poor man had nothing except one small ewe lamb that he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food and drank from his cup; it slept in his arms and was like a daughter to him.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Now a traveler came to the rich man, who refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for his guest.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: david
text: As surely as the LORD lives, the man who did this deserves to die!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Because he has done this thing and has shown no pity, he must pay for the lamb four times over.
name: David

speaker: nathan
text: You are that man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: I gave your master’s house to you and your master’s wives into your arms. I gave you the house of Israel and Judah, and if that was not enough, I would have given you even more.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Why then have you despised the command of the LORD by doing evil in His sight? You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own, for you have slain him with the sword of the Ammonites.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised Me and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.’
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘I will raise up adversity against you from your own house. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to another, and he will lie with them in broad daylight.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: You have acted in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: david
text: I have sinned against the LORD.
name: David

speaker: nathan
text: The LORD has taken away your sin,
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: You will not die.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Nevertheless, because by this deed you have shown utter contempt for the word of the LORD, the son born to you will surely die.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: david-servants
text: Look, while the child was alive, we spoke to him, and he would not listen to us. So how can we tell him the child is dead? He may even harm himself.
name: David's servants

speaker: david
text: Is the child dead?
name: David

speaker: david-servants
text: He is dead,
name: David's servants

speaker: david-servants
text: What is this you have done?
name: David's servants

speaker: david-servants
text: While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but when he died, you got up and ate.
name: David's servants

speaker: david
text: While the child was alive, I fasted and wept, for I said, ‘Who knows? The LORD may be gracious to me and let him live.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: I have fought against Rabbah and have captured the water supply of the city.
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Now, therefore, assemble the rest of the troops, lay siege to the city, and capture it. Otherwise I will capture the city, and it will be named after me.
name: Joab

speaker: jonadab
text: Why are you, the son of the king, so depressed morning after morning? Won’t you tell me?
name: Jonadab

speaker: amnon
text: I am in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.
name: Amnon

speaker: jonadab
text: Lie down on your bed and pretend you are ill. When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare it in my sight so I may watch her and eat it from her hand.’
name: Jonadab

speaker: amnon
text: Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of cakes in my sight, so that I may eat from her hand.
name: Amnon

speaker: david
text: Please go to the house of Amnon your brother and prepare a meal for him.
name: David

speaker: amnon
text: Send everyone away!
name: Amnon

speaker: amnon
text: Bring the food into the bedroom, so that I may eat it from your hand.
name: Amnon

speaker: amnon
text: Come lie with me, my sister!
name: Amnon

speaker: tamar
text: No, my brother!
name: Tamar

speaker: tamar
text: Do not humiliate me, for such a thing should never be done in Israel. Do not do this disgraceful thing!
name: Tamar

speaker: tamar
text: Where could I ever take my shame? And you would be like one of the fools in Israel! Please speak to the king, for he will not withhold me from you.
name: Tamar

speaker: amnon
text: Get up!
name: Amnon

speaker: amnon
text: Be gone!
name: Amnon

speaker: tamar
text: No,
name: Tamar

speaker: tamar
text: sending me away is worse than this great wrong you have already done to me!
name: Tamar

speaker: amnon
text: Throw this woman out and bolt the door behind her!
name: Amnon

speaker: absalom
text: Has your brother Amnon been with you? Be quiet for now, my sister. He is your brother. Do not take this thing to heart.
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: Your servant has just hired shearers. Will the king and his servants please come with me?
name: Absalom

speaker: david
text: No, my son,
name: David

speaker: david
text: we should not all go, or we would be a burden to you.
name: David

speaker: absalom
text: If not,
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: please let my brother Amnon go with us.
name: Absalom

speaker: david
text: Why should he go with you?
name: David

speaker: absalom
text: Watch Amnon until his heart is merry with wine, and when I order you to strike Amnon down, you are to kill him. Do not be afraid. Have I not commanded you? Be courageous and valiant!
name: Absalom

speaker: messenger
text: Absalom has struck down all the sons of the king; not one of them is left!
name: Joab's messenger

speaker: jonadab
text: My lord must not think they have killed all the sons of the king, for only Amnon is dead. In fact, Absalom has planned this since the day Amnon violated his sister Tamar.
name: Jonadab

speaker: jonadab
text: So now, my lord the king, do not take to heart the report that all the sons of the king are dead. Only Amnon is dead.
name: Jonadab

speaker: watchman
text: I see men coming from the direction of Horonaim, along the side of the hill.
name: The watchman

speaker: jonadab
text: Look, the sons of the king have arrived! It is just as your servant said.
name: Jonadab

speaker: joab
text: Please pretend to be a mourner; put on clothes for mourning and do not anoint yourself with oil. Act like a woman who has mourned for the dead a long time.
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Then go to the king and speak these words to him.
name: Joab

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Help me, O king!
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: What troubles you?
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Indeed,
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: I am a widow, for my husband is dead.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: And your maidservant had two sons who were fighting in the field with no one to separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Now the whole clan has risen up against your maidservant and said, ‘Hand over the one who struck down his brother, that we may put him to death for the life of the brother whom he killed. Then we will cut off the heir as well!’ So they would extinguish my one remaining ember by not preserving my husband’s name or posterity on the earth.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: Go home,
name: David

speaker: david
text: and I will give orders on your behalf.
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: My lord the king, may any blame be on me and on my father’s house, and may the king and his throne be guiltless.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: If anyone speaks to you,
name: David

speaker: david
text: bring him to me, and he will not trouble you again!
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Please,
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: may the king invoke the LORD your God to prevent the avenger of blood from increasing the devastation, so that my son may not be destroyed!
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: As surely as the LORD lives,
name: David

speaker: david
text: not a hair of your son’s head will fall to the ground.
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Please, may your servant speak a word to my lord the king?
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: Speak,
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Why have you devised a thing like this against the people of God? When the king says this, does he not convict himself, since he has not brought back his own banished son?
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: For surely we will die and be like water poured out on the ground, which cannot be recovered. Yet God does not take away a life; but He devises ways that the banished one may not be cast out from Him.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Now therefore, I have come to present this matter to my lord the king because the people have made me afraid. Your servant thought, ‘I will speak to the king. Perhaps he will grant the request of his maidservant.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: For the king will hear and deliver his maidservant from the hand of the man who would cut off both me and my son from God’s inheritance.’
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: And now your servant says, ‘May the word of my lord the king bring me rest, for my lord the king is able to discern good and evil, just like the angel of God. May the LORD your God be with you.’
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: I am going to ask you something; do not conceal it from me!
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Let my lord the king speak,
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: Is the hand of Joab behind all this?
name: David

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: As surely as you live, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right or to the left from anything that my lord the king says. Yes, your servant Joab is the one who gave me orders; he told your maidservant exactly what to say.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: woman-of-tekoa
text: Joab your servant has done this to bring about this change of affairs, but my lord has wisdom like the wisdom of the angel of God, to know everything that happens in the land.
name: The wise woman of Tekoa

speaker: david
text: I hereby grant this request. Go, bring back the young man Absalom.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: Today,
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: your servant knows that he has found favor with you, my lord the king, because the king has granted his request.
name: Joab

speaker: david
text: He may return to his house, but he must not see my face.
name: David

speaker: absalom
text: Look, Joab’s field is next to mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire!
name: Absalom

speaker: joab
text: Why did your servants set my field on fire?
name: Joab

speaker: absalom
text: Look,
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: I sent for you and said, ‘Come here. I want to send you to the king to ask: Why have I come back from Geshur? It would be better for me if I were still there.’ So now, let me see the king’s face, and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: What city are you from?
name: Absalom

speaker: unnamed-israelite
text: Your servant is from one of the tribes of Israel,
name: A man with a grievance

speaker: absalom
text: Look, your claims are good and right, but the king has no deputy to hear you.
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: If only someone would appoint me judge in the land, then everyone with a grievance or dispute could come to me, and I would give him justice.
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: Please let me go to Hebron to fulfill a vow I have made to the LORD.
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: For your servant made a vow while dwelling in Geshur of Aram, saying: ‘If indeed the LORD brings me back to Jerusalem, I will worship the LORD in Hebron.’
name: Absalom

speaker: david
text: Go in peace,
name: David

speaker: absalom
text: When you hear the sound of the horn, you are to say, ‘Absalom reigns in Hebron!’
name: Absalom

speaker: messenger
text: The hearts of the men of Israel are with Absalom.
name: Joab's messenger

speaker: david
text: Arise and let us flee, or we will not escape from Absalom! We must leave quickly, or he will soon overtake us, heap disaster on us, and put the city to the sword.
name: David

speaker: david-servants
text: Whatever our lord the king decides, we are your servants.
name: David's servants

speaker: david
text: Why should you also go with us? Go back and stay with the new king, since you are both a foreigner and an exile from your homeland.
name: David

speaker: david
text: In fact, you arrived only yesterday; should I make you wander around with us today while I do not know where I am going? Go back and take your brothers with you. May the LORD show you loving devotion and faithfulness.
name: David

speaker: ittai
text: As surely as the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether it means life or death, there will your servant be!
name: Ittai the Gittite

speaker: david
text: March on then,
name: David

speaker: david
text: Return the ark of God to the city. If I find favor in the eyes of the LORD, He will bring me back and let me see both it and His dwelling place again.
name: David

speaker: david
text: But if He should say, ‘I do not delight in you,’ then here I am; let Him do to me whatever seems good to Him.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Are you not a seer? Return to the city in peace—you with your son Ahimaaz, and Abiathar with his son Jonathan.
name: David

speaker: david
text: See, I will wait at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.
name: David

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.
name: An informant

speaker: david
text: O LORD, please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness!
name: David

speaker: david
text: If you go on with me, you will be a burden to me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: But you can thwart the counsel of Ahithophel for me if you return to the city and say to Absalom: ‘I will be your servant, my king; in the past I was your father’s servant, but now I will be your servant.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Will not Zadok and Abiathar the priests be there with you? Report to them everything you hear from the king’s palace.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Indeed, their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with everything you hear.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Why do you have these?
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride, the bread and summer fruit are for the young men to eat, and the wine is to refresh those who become exhausted in the wilderness.
name: Ziba

speaker: david
text: Where is your master’s grandson?
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: Indeed, he is staying in Jerusalem, for he has said, ‘Today, the house of Israel will restore to me the kingdom of my grandfather.’
name: Ziba

speaker: david
text: All that belongs to Mephibosheth is now yours!
name: David

speaker: ziba
text: I humbly bow before you,
name: Ziba

speaker: ziba
text: May I find favor in your eyes, my lord the king!
name: Ziba

speaker: shimei
text: Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!
name: Shimei

speaker: shimei
text: The LORD has paid you back for all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose place you have reigned, and the LORD has delivered the kingdom into the hand of your son Absalom. See, you have come to ruin because you are a man of bloodshed!
name: Shimei

speaker: abishai
text: Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head!
name: Abishai

speaker: david
text: What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah? If he curses me because the LORD told him, ‘Curse David,’ who can ask, ‘Why did you do this?’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Behold, my own son, my own flesh and blood, seeks my life. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone and let him curse me, for the LORD has told him so.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Perhaps the LORD will see my affliction and repay me with good for the cursing I receive today.
name: David

speaker: hushai
text: Long live the king! Long live the king!
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: absalom
text: Is this the loyalty you show your friend?
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: Why did you not go with your friend?
name: Absalom

speaker: hushai
text: Not at all,
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: For the one chosen by the LORD, by the people, and by all the men of Israel—his I will be, and with him I will remain.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: Furthermore, whom should I serve if not the son? As I served in your father’s presence, so also I will serve in yours.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: absalom
text: Give me counsel. What should we do?
name: Absalom

speaker: ahithophel
text: Sleep with your father’s concubines, whom he has left to keep the palace. When all Israel hears that you have become a stench to your father, then the hands of all who are with you will be strengthened.
name: Ahithophel

speaker: ahithophel
text: Let me choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.
name: Ahithophel

speaker: ahithophel
text: I will attack him while he is weak and weary; I will throw him into a panic, and all the people with him will flee; I will strike down only the king
name: Ahithophel

speaker: ahithophel
text: and bring all the people back to you as a bride returning to her husband. You seek the life of only one man; then all the people will be at peace.
name: Ahithophel

speaker: absalom
text: Summon Hushai the Archite as well, and let us hear what he too has to say.
name: Absalom

speaker: absalom
text: Ahithophel has spoken this proposal. Should we carry it out? If not, what do you say?
name: Absalom

speaker: hushai
text: This time the advice of Ahithophel is not sound.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: You know your father and his men. They are mighty men, and as fierce as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Moreover, your father is a man of war who will not spend the night with the troops.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: Surely by now he is hiding in a cave or some other location. If some of your troops fall first, whoever hears of it will say, ‘There has been a slaughter among the troops who follow Absalom.’
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: Then even the most valiant soldier with the heart of a lion will melt with fear, because all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man who has valiant men with him.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: Instead, I advise that all Israel from Dan to Beersheba—a multitude like the sand on the seashore—be gathered to you, and that you yourself lead them into battle.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: Then we will attack David wherever we find him, and we will descend on him like dew on the ground. And of all the men with him, not even one will remain.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: If he retreats to a city, all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not even a pebble can be found.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: absalom
text: The advice of Hushai the Archite is better than that of Ahithophel.
name: Absalom

speaker: hushai
text: This is what Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel, and this is what I have advised.
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: hushai
text: Now send quickly and tell David, ‘Do not spend the night at the fords of the wilderness, but be sure to cross over. Otherwise the king and all the people with him will be swallowed up.’
name: Hushai the Archite

speaker: absalom-servants
text: Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?
name: Absalom's servants

speaker: bahurim-woman
text: They have crossed over the brook,
name: The woman in Bahurim

speaker: ahimaaz-and-jonathan
text: Get up and cross over the river at once, for Ahithophel has given this advice against you.
name: Ahimaaz and Jonathan

speaker: barzillai-and-friends
text: The people have become hungry, exhausted, and thirsty in the wilderness.
name: Shobi, Machir and Barzillai

speaker: david
text: I will surely march out with you as well.
name: David

speaker: david-troops
text: You must not go out! For if we have to flee, they will pay no attention to us. Even if half of us die, they will not care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It is better for now if you support us from the city.
name: David's troops

speaker: david
text: I will do whatever seems best to you,
name: David

speaker: david
text: Treat the young man Absalom gently for my sake.
name: David

speaker: unnamed-soldier
text: I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree!
name: A soldier

speaker: joab
text: You just saw him!
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Why did you not strike him to the ground right there? I would have given you ten shekels of silver and a warrior’s belt!
name: Joab

speaker: unnamed-soldier
text: Even if a thousand shekels of silver were weighed out into my hands, I would not raise my hand against the son of the king. For we heard the king command you and Abishai and Ittai, ‘Protect the young man Absalom for my sake.’
name: A soldier

speaker: unnamed-soldier
text: If I had jeopardized my own life—and nothing is hidden from the king—you would have abandoned me.
name: A soldier

speaker: joab
text: I am not going to wait like this with you!
name: Joab

speaker: absalom
text: I have no son to preserve the memory of my name.
name: Absalom

speaker: ahimaaz
text: Please let me run and tell the king the good news that the LORD has avenged him of his enemies.
name: Ahimaaz

speaker: joab
text: You are not the man to take good news today. You may do it another day, but you must not do so today, because the king’s son is dead.
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Go, tell the king what you have seen.
name: Joab

speaker: ahimaaz
text: Regardless of whatever may happen, please let me also run behind the Cushite!
name: Ahimaaz

speaker: joab
text: My son,
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: why do you want to run, since you will not receive a reward?
name: Joab

speaker: ahimaaz
text: No matter what, I want to run!
name: Ahimaaz

speaker: joab
text: Then run!
name: Joab

speaker: david
text: If he is alone,
name: David

speaker: david
text: he bears good news.
name: David

speaker: watchman
text: Look! Another man is running alone!
name: The watchman

speaker: david
text: This one also brings good news,
name: David

speaker: watchman
text: The first man appears to me to be running like Ahimaaz son of Zadok.
name: The watchman

speaker: david
text: This is a good man,
name: David

speaker: david
text: He comes with good news.
name: David

speaker: ahimaaz
text: All is well!
name: Ahimaaz

speaker: ahimaaz
text: Blessed be the LORD your God! He has delivered up the men who raised their hands against my lord the king.
name: Ahimaaz

speaker: david
text: Is the young man Absalom all right?
name: David

speaker: ahimaaz
text: When Joab sent the king’s servant and your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I do not know what it was.
name: Ahimaaz

speaker: david
text: Move aside,
name: David

speaker: david
text: and stand here.
name: David

speaker: cushite
text: May my lord the king hear the good news: Today the LORD has avenged you of all who rose up against you!
name: The Cushite

speaker: david
text: Is the young man Absalom all right?
name: David

speaker: cushite
text: May what has become of the young man happen to the enemies of my lord the king and to all who rise up against you to harm you.
name: The Cushite

speaker: david
text: O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you, O Absalom, my son, my son!
name: David

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: The king is weeping and mourning over Absalom.
name: An informant

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: The king is grieving over his son.
name: An informant

speaker: david
text: O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!
name: David

speaker: joab
text: Today you have disgraced all your servants who have saved your life and the lives of your sons and daughters, of your wives, and of your concubines.
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: You love those who hate you and hate those who love you! For you have made it clear today that the commanders and soldiers mean nothing to you. I know today that if Absalom were alive and all of us were dead, it would have pleased you!
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Now therefore get up! Go out and speak comfort to your servants, for I swear by the LORD that if you do not go out, not a man will remain with you tonight. This will be worse for you than all the adversity that has befallen you from your youth until now!
name: Joab

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.
name: An informant

speaker: israelites
text: The king rescued us from the hand of our enemies and delivered us from the hand of the Philistines, but now he has fled the land because of Absalom.
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: But Absalom, the man we anointed over us, has died in battle. So why do you say nothing about restoring the king?
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: david
text: Say to the elders of Judah, ‘Why should you be the last to restore the king to his palace, since the talk of all Israel has reached the king at his quarters?
name: David

speaker: david
text: You are my brothers, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to restore the king?’
name: David

speaker: david
text: And say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my flesh and blood? May God punish me, and ever so severely, if from this time you are not the commander of my army in place of Joab!’
name: David

speaker: men-of-judah
text: Return, you and all your servants.
name: The men of Judah

speaker: shimei
text: My lord, do not hold me guilty, and do not remember your servant’s wrongdoing on the day my lord the king left Jerusalem. May the king not take it to heart.
name: Shimei

speaker: shimei
text: For your servant knows that I have sinned, so here I am today as the first of all the house of Joseph to come down to meet my lord the king.
name: Shimei

speaker: abishai
text: Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?
name: Abishai

speaker: david
text: Sons of Zeruiah, what have I to do with you, that you should be my adversaries today? Should any man be put to death in Israel today? Am I not indeed aware that today I am king over Israel?
name: David

speaker: david
text: You shall not die.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Mephibosheth, why did you not go with me?
name: David

speaker: mephibosheth
text: My lord the king,
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: mephibosheth
text: because I am lame, I said, ‘I will have my donkey saddled so that I may ride on it and go with the king.’ But my servant Ziba deceived me,
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: mephibosheth
text: and he has slandered your servant to my lord the king. Yet my lord the king is like the angel of God, so do what is good in your eyes.
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: mephibosheth
text: For all the house of my grandfather deserves death from my lord the king, yet you have set your servant among those who eat at your table. What further right, then, do I have to keep appealing to the king?
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: david
text: Why say any more? I hereby declare that you and Ziba are to divide the land.
name: David

speaker: mephibosheth
text: Instead, since my lord the king has safely come to his own house, let Ziba take it all!
name: Mephibosheth

speaker: david
text: Cross over with me, and I will provide for you at my side in Jerusalem.
name: David

speaker: barzillai
text: How many years of my life remain, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?
name: Barzillai

speaker: barzillai
text: I am now eighty years old. Can I discern what is good and what is not? Can your servant taste what he eats or drinks? Can I still hear the voice of singing men and women? Why should your servant be an added burden to my lord the king?
name: Barzillai

speaker: barzillai
text: Your servant could go with the king only a short distance past the Jordan; why should the king repay me with such a reward?
name: Barzillai

speaker: barzillai
text: Please let your servant return, that I may die in my own city near the tomb of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham. Let him cross over with my lord the king, and do for him what is good in your sight.
name: Barzillai

speaker: david
text: Chimham will cross over with me, and I will do for him what seems good in your sight, and I will do for you whatever you desire of me.
name: David

speaker: israelites
text: Why did our brothers, the men of Judah, take you away secretly and bring the king and his household across the Jordan, together with all of David’s men?
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: men-of-judah
text: We did this because the king is our relative. Why does this anger you? Have we ever eaten at the king’s expense or received anything for ourselves?
name: The men of Judah

speaker: israelites
text: We have ten shares in the king,
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: israelites
text: so we have more claim to David than you. Why then do you despise us? Were we not the first to speak of restoring our king?
name: The tribes of Israel

speaker: sheba
text: We have no share in David, no inheritance in Jesse’s son. Every man to his tent, O Israel!
name: Sheba son of Bichri

speaker: david
text: Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and elude us.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: Are you well, my brother?
name: Joab

speaker: joab-young-man
text: Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!
name: One of Joab's young men

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: Listen! Listen! Please tell Joab to come here so that I may speak with him.
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: Are you Joab?
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: joab
text: I am,
name: Joab

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: Listen to the words of your servant,
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: joab
text: I am listening,
name: Joab

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: Long ago they used to say, ‘Seek counsel at Abel,’ and that is how disputes were settled.
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: I am among the peaceable and faithful in Israel, but you are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: joab
text: Far be it!
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
name: Joab

speaker: joab
text: That is not the case. But a man named Sheba son of Bichri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Deliver him alone, and I will depart from the city.
name: Joab

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: Look,
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: wise-woman-of-abel
text: his head will be thrown to you over the wall.
name: The wise woman of Abel

speaker: god
text: It is because of the blood shed by Saul and his family, because he killed the Gibeonites.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: What shall I do for you? How can I make amends so that you may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
name: David

speaker: gibeonites
text: We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us.
name: The Gibeonites

speaker: david
text: Whatever you ask, I will do for you,
name: David

speaker: gibeonites
text: As for the man who consumed us and plotted against us to exterminate us from existing within any border of Israel,
name: The Gibeonites

speaker: gibeonites
text: let seven of his male descendants be delivered to us so that we may hang them before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.
name: The Gibeonites

speaker: david
text: I will give them to you,
name: David

speaker: david-men
text: You must never again go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.
name: David's men

speaker: david
text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
name: David

speaker: david
text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.
name: David

speaker: david
text: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
name: David

speaker: david
text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.
name: David

speaker: david
text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
name: David

speaker: david
text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
name: David

speaker: david
text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
name: David

speaker: david
text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
name: David

speaker: david
text: God is my strong fortress and He makes my way clear.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
name: David

speaker: david
text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: They looked, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
name: David

speaker: david
text: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.
name: David

speaker: david
text: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
name: David

speaker: david
text: the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,
name: David

speaker: david
text: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The oracle of David son of Jesse, the oracle of the man raised on high, the one anointed by the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel:
name: David

speaker: david
text: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; His word was on my tongue.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The God of Israel spoke; the Rock of Israel said to me, ‘He who rules the people with justice, who rules in the fear of God,
name: David

speaker: david
text: is like the light of the morning at sunrise of a cloudless dawn, the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Is not my house right with God? For He has established with me an everlasting covenant, ordered and secured in every part. Will He not bring about my full salvation and my every desire?
name: David

speaker: david
text: But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside, for they can never be gathered by hand.
name: David

speaker: david
text: The man who touches them must be armed with iron or with the shaft of a spear. The fire burns them to ashes in the place where they lie.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!
name: David

speaker: david
text: Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this! Is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives?
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go and take a census of Israel and Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Go now throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and register the troops, so that I may know their number.
name: David

speaker: joab
text: May the LORD your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?
name: Joab

speaker: david
text: I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, O LORD, I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.
name: David

speaker: god
text: Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’
name: The LORD

speaker: gad
text: Do you choose to endure three years of famine in your land, three months of fleeing the pursuit of your enemies, or three days of plague upon your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.
name: Gad the prophet

speaker: david
text: I am deeply distressed. Please, let us fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.
name: David

speaker: god
text: Enough! Withdraw your hand now!
name: The LORD

speaker: david
text: Surely I, the shepherd, have sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? Please, let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house.
name: David

speaker: gad
text: Go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
name: Gad the prophet

speaker: araunah
text: Why has my lord the king come to his servant?
name: Araunah

speaker: david
text: To buy your threshing floor,
name: David

speaker: david
text: that I may build an altar to the LORD, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.
name: David

speaker: araunah
text: My lord the king may take whatever seems good and offer it up. Here are the oxen for a burnt offering and the threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.
name: Araunah

speaker: araunah
text: O king, Araunah gives all these to the king.
name: Araunah

speaker: araunah
text: May the LORD your God accept you.
name: Araunah

speaker: david
text: No,
name: David

speaker: david
text: I insist on paying a price, for I will not offer to the LORD my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing.
name: David
